title: Ledger and Lantern
author: Mirabel Joubert
blurb: Juniper Dunmore, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
